package checks

// Generator of testdata/security-oracle.json (TypeScript port, ticket 19).
// The Go code is frozen, so this file is kept as text: copy it to
// internal/checks/zz_security_oracle_test.go, run
//
//	go test ./internal/checks -run TestZZSecurityOracle -count=1
//
// and delete the copy. It records what the security Checks make of hostile
// input without Docker: the osv-scanner report reader and its verdict, the
// version order, the severities, the scanned copy of the lockfile, the
// coverage Limitation, the dependency Findings, the three native lockfile
// Checks on inline projects, and the security.patterns readers, rewrite,
// ignore comments and tar copy.
//
// Strings that may hold bytes that are no UTF-8 are written as byte strings
// (one character U+0000 to U+00FF per byte); file contents are base64.

import (
	"archive/tar"
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/invia-flights/jscript-bench/internal/discovery"
	"github.com/invia-flights/jscript-bench/internal/lockfile"
	"github.com/invia-flights/jscript-bench/internal/resultset"
)

func zzBS(s string) string {
	r := make([]rune, len(s))
	for i := 0; i < len(s); i++ {
		r[i] = rune(s[i])
	}
	return string(r)
}

// zzJSON is json.Marshal of v (HTML escaping on), as text.
func zzJSON(t *testing.T, v any) string {
	data, err := json.Marshal(v)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return string(data)
}

func zzFindings(fs []resultset.Finding) []resultset.Finding {
	if fs == nil {
		return []resultset.Finding{}
	}
	return fs
}

type zzProject struct {
	Name  string            `json:"name"`
	Files map[string]string `json:"files"` // path -> base64
}

func zzWrite(t *testing.T, files map[string]string) (string, map[string]string) {
	dir := t.TempDir()
	dir, _ = filepath.EvalSymlinks(dir)
	enc := map[string]string{}
	for name, content := range files {
		p := filepath.Join(dir, filepath.FromSlash(name))
		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(p), 0o755); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := os.WriteFile(p, []byte(content), 0o644); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		enc[name] = base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(content))
	}
	return dir, enc
}

func zzInput(t *testing.T, dir, pkgPath string) *Input {
	proj, err := discovery.Discover(dir)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for i := range proj.Contexts {
		if c := &proj.Contexts[i]; c.Package != nil && c.Package.Path == pkgPath {
			return &Input{Project: proj, Context: c, OriginalPath: "/original", SnapshotDir: dir}
		}
	}
	t.Fatalf("no package %s", pkgPath)
	return nil
}

func zzLock(t *testing.T, entries string) *lockfile.Lock {
	l, err := lockfile.ParseLock([]byte(`{"lockfileVersion": 3, "packages": {"": {"name": "x"}, ` + entries + `}}`))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return l
}

type zzFail struct {
	Status string `json:"status"`
	Code   string `json:"code"`
	Reason string `json:"reason"`
}

type zzJudge struct {
	Name       string     `json:"name"`
	Exit       int        `json:"exit"`
	Report     string     `json:"report"` // byte string
	Entries    string     `json:"entries"`
	Advisories []advisory `json:"advisories"`
	Panic      string     `json:"panic"`
	Fail       *zzFail    `json:"fail"`
	Partial    string     `json:"partial"`
	// Findings are the dependency Findings of the advisories, against a
	// project with the same lockfile, for the database date below.
	Findings string `json:"findings"`
}

	"src/a.js":     "x\n// njsscan-ignore: express_open_redirect\ny\n",
	"src/b.js":     "z // nosemgrep\n// njsscan-ignore\nconst s = 'njsscan-ignore in a string';\n",
	"src/c.js":     "/* nosemgrep */ // nosemgrep\n///nosemgrep:rule\n/** njsscan-ignore */\n * nosemgrep\n  ** njsscan-ignore\n# nosemgrep\n<!-- nosemgrep -->\n// nosemgrepx\n// njsscan-ignored\n//\vnosemgrep\n//\fnosemgrep\n//\rnosemgrep\n// nosemgrep_\n// nosemgrep-x\n// nosemgrepé\n/ nosemgrep\n// NOSEMGREP\n#nosemgrep#nosemgrep\n // nosemgrep\n * nosemgrep\r\n",
	"src/d.js":     "x\x00 // nosemgrep\n",
	"src/e.ts":     "// nosemgrep\n",
	"src/f.html":   "<!-- njsscan-ignore -->\n",
	"src/.g.js":    "// nosemgrep\n",
	"test/a.test.js": "// njsscan-ignore\n",
}

func TestZZSecurityOracle(t *testing.T) {
	out := map[string]any{
		"recordedFrom": "238e07f66d8cafab24ef363cb79e207bd48babd8",
		"date":         zzDate,
	}

	// The osv-scanner report reader, the verdict and the dependency Findings.
	var judges []zzJudge
	for _, c := range zzReports {
		lock := zzLock(t, c.entries)
		j := zzJudge{Name: c.name, Exit: c.exit, Report: zzBS(c.report), Entries: c.entries}
		func() {
			defer func() {
				if r := recover(); r != nil {
					j.Panic = strings.TrimPrefix(fmt.Sprint(r), "")
				}
			}()
			v := judgeScan(c.exit, []byte(c.report), lock)
			j.Advisories, j.Partial = v.Advisories, v.Partial
			if v.Fail != nil {
				j.Fail = &zzFail{string(v.Fail.Status), v.Fail.Code, v.Fail.Reason}
			}
			dir, _ := zzWrite(t, map[string]string{
				"package.json":      `{"name": "x", "version": "1.0.0"}`,
				"package-lock.json": `{"lockfileVersion": 3, "packages": {"": {"name": "x"}, ` + c.entries + `}}`,
			})
			in := zzInput(t, dir, ".")
			src, res := dependencyLockfile(in)
			if res != nil {
				t.Fatalf("%s: %+v", c.name, res)
			}
			var fs []resultset.Finding
			for _, a := range v.Advisories {
				fs = append(fs, in.dependencyFinding(a, src, zzDate))
			}
			src.produced, src.located, src.path = true, nil, "package.json"
			for _, a := range v.Advisories {
				fs = append(fs, in.dependencyFinding(a, src, zzDate))
			}
			j.Findings = zzJSON(t, zzFindings(fs))
		}()
		judges = append(judges, j)
	}
	out["judge"] = judges

	var order []int
	for _, a := range zzVersions {
		for _, b := range zzVersions {
			order = append(order, compareVersions(a, b))
		}
	}
	out["versions"] = zzVersions
	out["versionOrder"] = order

	type sev struct {
		In    string `json:"in"`
		Score string `json:"score"`
		Word  string `json:"word"`
	}
	var sevs []sev
	for _, s := range zzSeverities {
		sevs = append(sevs, sev{s, severityScore(s), severityWord(s)})
	}
	out["severities"] = sevs

	type scan struct {
		In        string   `json:"in"`
		Err       string   `json:"err"`
		Dropped   []string `json:"dropped"`
		Unchanged bool     `json:"unchanged"`
		Kept      []string `json:"kept"`
		ParseErr  string   `json:"parseErr"`
		Out       string   `json:"out"`
	}
	var scans []scan
	for _, raw := range zzScannable {
		s := scan{In: zzBS(raw), Dropped: []string{}, Kept: []string{}}
		filtered, dropped, err := scannableLockfile([]byte(raw))
		if err != nil {
			s.Err = err.Error()
		} else {
			s.Unchanged = string(filtered) == raw
			s.Out = zzBS(string(filtered))
			s.Dropped = append(s.Dropped, dropped...)
			if l, err := lockfile.ParseLock(filtered); err != nil {
				s.ParseErr = err.Error()
			} else {
				for k := range l.Packages {
					s.Kept = append(s.Kept, k)
				}
				sort.Strings(s.Kept)
			}
		}
		scans = append(scans, s)
	}
	out["scannable"] = scans

	type cover struct {
		Entries    string   `json:"entries"`
		NotCovered []string `json:"notCovered"`
		Limitation string   `json:"limitation"`
		Locked     []string `json:"locked"`
	}
	var covers []cover
	for _, e := range zzCoverage {
		lock := zzLock(t, e)
		c := cover{Entries: e, NotCovered: append([]string{}, notCoveredPackages(lock)...)}
		if l := notCoveringLimitation(lock, "sub/package-lock.json"); l != nil {
			c.Limitation = zzJSON(t, l)
		}
		for k := range lockedPackages(lock) {
			c.Locked = append(c.Locked, k)
		}
		sort.Strings(c.Locked)
		covers = append(covers, c)
	}
	out["coverage"] = covers

	// The native lockfile Checks.
	type native struct {
		Project     zzProject `json:"project"`
		Check       string    `json:"check"`
		Package     string    `json:"package"`
		Status      string    `json:"status"`
		ReasonCode  string    `json:"reasonCode"`
		Reason      string    `json:"reason"`
		Findings    string    `json:"findings"`
		Metrics     string    `json:"metrics"`
		Limitations string    `json:"limitations"`
	}
	var natives []native
	for _, p := range zzLockfileProjects {
		dir, enc := zzWrite(t, p.files)
		pkg := "."
		if _, ok := p.files["packages/lib/package.json"]; ok {
			pkg = "packages/lib"
		}
		for _, id := range []string{securityIntegrityID, securityLicensesID, packageInstallScriptsID} {
			in := zzInput(t, dir, pkg)
			res := Implementation(id).Run(context.Background(), in)
			metrics := res.Metrics
			if metrics == nil {
				metrics = []resultset.Metric{}
			}
			lims := res.Limitations
			if lims == nil {
				lims = []resultset.Limitation{}
			}
			natives = append(natives, native{
				Project: zzProject{p.name, enc}, Check: id, Package: pkg,
				Status: string(res.Status), ReasonCode: res.ReasonCode, Reason: res.Reason,
				Findings: zzJSON(t, zzFindings(res.Findings)), Metrics: zzJSON(t, metrics), Limitations: zzJSON(t, lims),
			})
		}
	}
	out["native"] = natives

	// security.patterns.
	type rewrite struct {
		In    string `json:"in"`
		Out   string `json:"out"`
		Match bool   `json:"match"`
	}
	var rewrites []rewrite
	for _, s := range zzRewrite {
		rewrites = append(rewrites, rewrite{zzBS(s), zzBS(string(rewriteCommentOpeners([]byte(s)))), patternsRegexWithOpener.MatchString(s)})
	}
	out["rewrite"] = rewrites

	dir, enc := zzWrite(t, zzIgnoreFiles)
	in := zzInput(t, dir, ".")
	njs, nosem := patternsIgnoreLines(in)
	out["ignore"] = map[string]any{"files": enc, "njsscan": njs, "nosemgrep": nosem, "candidates": patternsFiles(in.Context.Package)}

	type report struct {
		Tool     string   `json:"tool"`
		Package  string   `json:"package"`
		Report   string   `json:"report"`
		Rewritten []string `json:"rewritten"`
		Findings string   `json:"findings"`
		Unparsed []string `json:"unparsed"`
		Err      string   `json:"err"`
	}
	reportFiles := map[string]string{
		"package.json":              `{"name":"root"}`,
		"packages/lib/package.json": `{"name":"lib"}`,
		"src/app.js":                "const a = 1;\n" + strings.Repeat("// filler\n", 16) + "  res.send(String(eval(req.query.expr)));\r\nline 19\nline 20\n",
		"packages/lib/src/app.js":   "a\nb\nc\nd\ne\nf\ng\nh\ni\nj\nk\nl\n",
		"src/long.js":               strings.Repeat("x", 500) + "\n",
		"src/bad.js":                "ok \xff\xfe line\n",
		"views/index.ejs":           "<%- body %>\n",
	}
	rdir, renc := zzWrite(t, reportFiles)
	out["reportFiles"] = renc
	var reports []report
	for _, c := range []struct {
		tool, pkg, report string
		rewritten         []string
	}{
		{"njsscan", ".", njsscanEval, nil},
		{"njsscan", "packages/lib", njsscanEval, nil},
		{"njsscan", ".", "Traceback (most recent call last):\n", nil},
		{"njsscan", ".", `{"errors": [{"path": "/code/src/broken.js", "message": "Syntax error"}, {"path": "/elsewhere/x.js", "message": "a message that names no file but is long enough to be cut at the title length of the report so that we can see where it is cut and how; ` + strings.Repeat("x", 300) + `"}, {"path": "/code/../etc/passwd"}, {"path": "/code/"}, {"path": "/code/./src//a.js"}, {"message": ""}], "nodejs": {}, "templates": {}}`, nil},
		{"njsscan", ".", `{"nodejs": {"b_rule": {"files": [{"file_path": "/code/src/app.js", "match_lines": [18, 20], "match_position": [3], "match_string": "x"}, {"file_path": "/code/src/app.js", "match_lines": [], "match_string": "skipped"}, {"file_path": "/other/x.js", "match_lines": [1]}, {"file_path": "/code/src/app.js", "match_lines": [18, 20], "match_string": "x"}, {"file_path": "/code/src/app.js", "match_lines": [18], "match_position": [1, 2, 3], "match_string": "x"}], "metadata": {"cwe": "CWE-1", "description": "<desc>"}}, "a_rule": {"files": [{"file_path": "/code/src/long.js", "match_lines": [1, 1], "match_position": [1, 2], "match_string": ""}]}}, "templates": null}`, nil},
		{"njsscan", ".", `{"nodejs": {"r": {"files": [{"file_path": "/code/src/app.js", "match_lines": [18, 19], "match_string": "rewritten text"}]}}}`, []string{"src/app.js"}},
		{"njsscan", ".", `{"nodejs": {"r": {"files": [{"file_path": "/code/src/app.js", "match_lines": ["18"]}]}}}`, nil},
		{"njsscan", ".", `{"nodejs": {"r": {"files": [{"file_path": "/code/src/app.js", "match_lines": [1.5]}]}}}`, nil},
		{"semgrep", ".", semgrepEval, nil},
		{"semgrep", ".", `{"results": [
			{"check_id": "a.b.c.rule-x", "path": "/code/src/app.js", "start": {"line": 18, "col": 19}, "end": {"line": 30, "col": 0}, "extra": {"message": "m <b>"}},
			{"check_id": "plain", "path": "/code/src/app.js", "start": {"line": 0, "col": 0}, "end": {"line": 0, "col": 0}, "extra": {}},
			{"check_id": "x.y", "path": "/code/src/bad.js", "START": {"LINE": 1, "Col": 2}, "end": {"line": 1, "col": 5}, "extra": {"message": "bad bytes"}},
			{"check_id": "x.long", "path": "/code/src/long.js", "start": {"line": 1, "col": 1}, "end": {"line": 2, "col": 1}, "extra": {"message": "long"}},
			{"check_id": "x.past", "path": "/code/src/app.js", "start": {"line": 99, "col": 1}, "end": {"line": 100, "col": 1}, "extra": {"message": "past the end"}},
			{"check_id": "x.back", "path": "/code/src/app.js", "start": {"line": 5, "col": 1}, "end": {"line": 4, "col": 1}, "extra": {"message": "end before start"}},
			{"check_id": "x.out", "path": "/tmp/x.js", "start": {"line": 1, "col": 1}, "end": {"line": 1, "col": 1}, "extra": {"message": "outside"}},
			{"check_id": "x.missing", "path": "/code/src/none.js", "start": {"line": 1, "col": 1}, "end": {"line": 1, "col": 1}, "extra": {"message": "no file"}}
		], "errors": []}`, nil},
		{"semgrep", ".", `{"results": [{"check_id": 5}]}`, nil},
		{"semgrep", ".", `[]`, nil},
		{"semgrep", ".", `{"results": [{"start": {"line": "x"}}]}`, nil},
		{"njsscan", ".", `[1]`, nil},
		{"njsscan", ".", `{"nodejs": []}`, nil},
		{"njsscan", ".", `{"nodejs": {"r": {"metadata": {"cwe": 1}}}}`, nil},
		{"semgrep", ".", ``, nil},
	} {
		in := zzInput(t, rdir, c.pkg)
		r := report{Tool: c.tool, Package: c.pkg, Report: c.report, Rewritten: c.rewritten, Unparsed: []string{}}
		var fs []resultset.Finding
		var unparsed []string
		var err error
		if c.tool == "njsscan" {
			rw := map[string]bool{}
			for _, p := range c.rewritten {
				rw[p] = true
			}
			fs, unparsed, err = njsscanReport(in, []byte(c.report), rw)
		} else {
			fs, unparsed, err = semgrepReport(in, []byte(c.report))
		}
		if err != nil {
			r.Err = err.Error()
		}
		r.Findings = zzJSON(t, zzFindings(fs))
		r.Unparsed = append(r.Unparsed, unparsed...)
		reports = append(reports, r)
	}
	out["reports"] = reports

	// The tar copy of a package's Source code.
	tarFiles := map[string]string{
		"package.json":          `{"name":"x"}`,
		"src/a/b/c.js":          "const P = /<!--/;\n",
		"src/a/d.ts":            "x <!--\n",
		"src/big.js":            strings.Repeat("y", patternsMaxFileBytes+1),
		"src/exact.js":          strings.Repeat("z", patternsMaxFileBytes),
		"src/views/index.ejs":   "<%- body %>\n",
		"src/readme.md":         "not scanned\n",
		"lib/x.mjs":             "export {}\n",
	}
	tdir, tenc := zzWrite(t, tarFiles)
	if err := os.Symlink(filepath.Join(tdir, "src/a/d.ts"), filepath.Join(tdir, "src/link.js")); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	tin := zzInput(t, tdir, ".")
	type tarEntry struct {
		Name     string `json:"name"`
		Type     string `json:"type"`
		Mode     int64  `json:"mode"`
		Size     int64  `json:"size"`
		Content  string `json:"content"` // sha-less: the first 40 bytes
	}
	tarOf := func(files []string, rewrite bool) map[string]any {
		var buf bytes.Buffer
		oversized, err := writePatternsTar(&buf, tin, files, rewrite)
		res := map[string]any{"oversized": oversized, "bytes": base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(buf.Bytes())}
		if err != nil {
			res["err"] = err.Error()
		}
		var entries []tarEntry
		tr := tar.NewReader(bytes.NewReader(buf.Bytes()))
		for h, err := tr.Next(); err == nil; h, err = tr.Next() {
			data, _ := io.ReadAll(tr)
			if len(data) > 40 {
				data = data[:40]
			}
			entries = append(entries, tarEntry{h.Name, string(h.Typeflag), h.Mode, h.Size, string(data)})
		}
		res["entries"] = entries
		return res
	}
	files := patternsFiles(tin.Context.Package)
	out["tar"] = map[string]any{
		"files":     tenc,
		"symlink":   []string{"src/link.js", "src/a/d.ts"},
		"scanned":   files,
		"plain":     tarOf(files, false),
		"rewritten": tarOf([]string{"src/a/b/c.js", "src/a/d.ts"}, true),
	}
	out["rulesHash"] = patternsRulesHash()
	out["semgrepArgs"] = semgrepArgs()
	out["njsscanArgs"] = njsscanArgs
	out["osvArgs"] = osvArgs

	data, err := json.MarshalIndent(out, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile("testdata/security-oracle.json", append(data, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
